basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old software engineer based in Cork, Ireland. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, which I started exploring during the pandemic. When I'm not coding, you'll find me indulging in my passion for professional wrestling, a hobby I've enjoyed since childhood. I discovered Reddit about half a year ago, and it's been a great platform to connect with like-minded people and learn new things. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends hiking or exploring new cafes in town.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I graduated with a degree in Computer Science and have worked in the tech industry for over a decade. My knowledge in cryptocurrency stems from self-study and participating in online communities and forums. My interest in wrestling is purely recreational, driven by years of watching events and following storylines.
